chunks: From him, from al-Hasan, from Zur‘ah, from Sama‘ah, who said:

I asked him about forgetfulness in the morning prayer. He said: If you do not know whether you prayed one or two, then repeat the salat (prayer) from its beginning. And likewise the Friday prayer: if the Imam becomes forgetful in it, then he must repeat the salat (prayer), because it is two rak‘ahs. And the Maghrib prayer, if forgetfulness occurs in it and he does not know how many rak‘ahs he prayed, then he must repeat the salat (prayer).

key_terms.السَّهْوِ: forgetfulness or inadvertent doubt occurring during salat (prayer)
key_terms.صَلَاةِ الْغَدَاةِ: the morning obligatory salat (prayer), i.e. Fajr

ai.seo_question: What should be done if one doubts the number of rak‘ahs in Fajr, Jumu‘ah, or Maghrib prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning doubt in the number of rak‘ahs in certain obligatory prayers. It states that if uncertainty occurs in the morning prayer, Friday prayer, or Maghrib prayer in a way that leaves the number of rak‘ahs unknown, the salat (prayer) must be repeated from the beginning.
